name: Marketing Landing
primary_user_goal: Understand 1Password value proposition and decide to try it

name: Account Setup
primary_user_goal: Create account with secure master password and understand key concepts
business_goal: Ensure proper security foundation and reduce support burden from lockouts
exit_point: User reaches empty vault ready to add first item

name: Vault Navigation
primary_user_goal: Find and access stored credentials quickly
business_goal: Deliver core value and drive daily usage habit

name: Add New Item
primary_user_goal: Store a new credential or secure information
entry_point: New Item button or save prompt

name: Browser Auto-Fill
primary_user_goal: Fill login credentials without manual entry
business_goal: Demonstrate daily value and build usage habit
entry_point: Website login form or extension icon click

name: Security Monitoring
primary_user_goal: Understand and improve password security across all accounts
business_goal: Differentiate from competitors and justify ongoing subscription
entry_point: Watchtower menu item or security alert

name: Family Sharing
primary_user_goal: Securely share credentials with family members
business_goal: Drive family plan adoption and reduce churn through shared value
entry_point: Family section or share button on item
exit_point: Item or vault shared with family member
